plan: Drive: from Village of Nakusp, about 75 km (straight line times 1.3, estimate).
Park: 50.43637, -118.57552, pull off on Silver Park Mountain FSR (gravel road). Map links below.
Walk: 1.4 km NE, cross country, no trail mapped. Climb about 6 m, about 28 min at 3 km/h.
Hunt: deer, Sept, Oct, Nov, Dec (season rows). Watch the edge of the 2017 cutblock (700 m SW) at first and last light. Sit above it with the wind in your face and glass (Tip).
Use: your .308 Winchester with a 150 to 165 grain expanding bullet (Tip).
Legal: MU (Management Unit) 8-23, Region 8. Season rows below. Study aid only. The official regulations are the law.
Verify: Candidate, scout it first. Check posted signs. Private land can be unsigned. Data dates: roads 2026-10-16, private land 2026-10-09, closures 2026-10-16.
R4D-deer-walk-0003.popWhy: Popular (more hunters): MU 8-23: about 10,135 hunter days a year for mule deer and white tailed deer (2020 to 2024 mean), 3.87 days per square km, top third of BC MUs; access: average access. Estimate, about 50% sure (my pick).

tags.label: Good for 2
tags.why: Cover edge here (cutblock or burn): one hunter sits at a crossing or glasses, the other walks the edge slowly with the wind at their back toward the stander. Agree zones of fire, a meeting point and a time at the truck (Tip, lesson: Hunting with a partner). Pushes are on foot only (99%, synopsis page 11, item 25).
